title.value: Flexible Diffusion Modeling of Long Videos
title.justification: The title is stated on the first page of the document, clearly identifying the focus of the paper.
title.quote: Flexible Diffusion Modeling of Long Videos

analysis.description: This paper presents a framework for video modeling using denoising diffusion probabilistic models, capable of producing long-duration video completions. The flexible generative model, referred to as Flexible Diffusion Model (FDM), allows arbitrary sampling of video frames conditioned on other frames. It introduces a new autonomous driving video dataset and evaluates video modeling over prior work using this and other datasets.

type.justification: The paper involves creating a new framework for video modeling and testing it empirically on several datasets. It demonstrates improved video modeling over prior work through experiments.
type.quote: We demonstrate improved video modeling over prior work on a number of datasets and sample temporally coherent videos over 25 minutes in length.

name.justification: The paper focuses on video modeling, a significant area within Computer Vision, especially in generating photorealistic videos.
name.quote: Generative modeling of photo-realistic videos is at the frontier of what is possible with deep learning on currently-available hardware.

name.justification: The paper focuses specifically on the generation and modeling of long-duration videos.
name.quote: We present a framework for video modeling based on denoising diffusion probabilistic models that produces long-duration video completions.

name.justification: The paper introduces a generative model for producing videos using diffusion processes.
name.quote: We propose a flexible architecture based on the denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) framework.

name.justification: The FDM is the central contribution of the paper, introduced to flexibly sample and model long-duration videos.
name.quote: We call it a Flexible Diffusion Model, or FDM.

is_contributed.justification: The FDM is a new model introduced as the main contribution of the paper.
is_contributed.quote: Contributions (1) At the highest level, we claim to have concurrently developed one of the first denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM)-based video generative models.

is_executed.justification: The model is described and its execution includes sampling procedures that involve GPU computation, particularly for generating long videos.
is_executed.quote: Ideas for making sampling faster by decreasing the number of integration steps could be applied to our video model.

is_compared.justification: The FDM's performance is compared to other models like VDM, CWVAE, and TATS in terms of video quality metrics like FVD and others.
is_compared.quote: Both the diffusion-based methods, FDM and VDM, achieve significantly higher FVD scores than TATS and CWVAE.

name.justification: The CARLA Town01 dataset is introduced in this paper as a new autonomous driving video dataset, used to demonstrate the FDM's capabilities.
name.quote: We release a new autonomous driving video dataset along with a new video generative model performance metric that captures semantics more directly than the visual quality and comparison metrics currently in widespread use.
